opener_concept: A patio paved with square metre slabs, 6 across and 4 up: counting the slabs IS area (length x width = 24 m2); walking round the fence IS perimeter (6+4+6+4 = 20 m). Names the two ideas the whole lesson rests on before any formula.
rounding_notes: Guided walks avoid intermediate-rounding traps: semicircle/sector/ring finals computed from unrounded intermediates (e.g. 1/2*pi*36 not 113.1/2; pi*16 not 78.5-28.3), and reverse-angle fractions carried to 4 d.p. so *360 lands on the stored degree.
